obligations.reason: A deliverable at review-required risk or above may only be accepted by a reviewer independent of the implementer; the roster must therefore contain a reviewer regardless of which template was selected.
Changes to shipped behaviour are verified by execution, not by declaration, so the roster must carry a tester that can produce that evidence.
A change that spans systems needs an operator accountable for rollout, rollback and the runtime state it touches.
An approval that never reaches a human is not an approval; a liaison owns getting the decision request to a surface and the decision back.
Decision-support work converges too early without a role whose job is to argue the opposing position before the recommendation is written.
